entries.title: Create Dataset Email Message
entries.value:
Hello {displayName},

A new dataset with the dataset ID {datasetId} has been created.

By creating this dataset you confirm that:
- The data (or a closely related version) is not stored in any other public or institutional repository.
- All data owners, principal investigators/project managers have been informed about this submission and consent to the data upload.
- You have the necessary rights to share and publish this data.
- The metadata accurately reflects the uploaded files and relation to other datasets or publications (e.g. related DOIs).

Best regards,
Your {appName} Team
entries.description: Message for the create dataset email to the dataset creator. Supports placeholders: {displayName}, {datasetId}, {appName}.
